clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, the Simple Memorandum sends novice gnome warriors to Anvilmar. It directs them to train with Thran Khorman for the war to take back Gnomeregan.

The Simple Memorandum sends young gnome fighters to train in Anvilmar. As they face local wildlife and troggs in Coldridge Valley, they receive letters of introduction. This one directs its bearer to Thran Khorman, the warrior trainer there. Gnomes bring intellect and contraptions to battle, but taking back Gnomeregan calls for strength and martial discipline. The memorandum tells its bearer to leave early training behind and learn the art of war from Thran.
